sn23.3:1.3: Early Sanskrit _netrī_ always retains the expected grammatical sense, a noun from the root “to lead”, i.e. a “leader” (Rig Veda 1.113.4, 4.56.2, 5.50.2, 7.76.6, 7.77.2). The _bhavanetti_ is “that which leads to continued existence”. Compare the English concept of the psychopomp or ferryman who leads you to the afterlife.
